name: 每日混合坚果独立装款
description: 七种坚果果干的每日 30g 独立小包，主打新鲜锁鲜与无添加，适合办公加餐与儿童零食。

styleLock.direction: fresh natural snack brightness with warm nut tones
styleLock.backgroundSystem: white paper for packshots, light oak and linen for lifestyle
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft top-left key with gentle fill and crisp natural contact shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white paper, light oak, natural linen
styleLock.typography: Chinese sans-serif, warm brown on light zones
styleLock.presentationRules: keep nuts glossy-but-natural, never oily or plastic; green accent used sparingly
styleLock.lockText: Palette anchored on #FFFFFF clean paper with #8C5A2B nut brown, #E8C27A honey gold and a sparing #3B7A57 fresh green; white paper, light oak and natural linen surfaces; soft top-left daylight key at 5400K with natural crisp contact shadows; keep shade and light direction identical across all shots.

shots.intent: 搜索页第一眼识别产品与独立装形态
shots.lighting: high-key soft key from upper-left, even fill
shots.promptTemplate: {product_identity_lock} Product packshot of {product}, a stand-up pouch centered on a pure #FFFFFF seamless background, eye-level slight 3/4 view. The pouch occupies 35-40% of the frame with generous clean whitespace and a faint real contact shadow. Soft high-key key light from the upper-left at 45 degrees with even fill; matte film with legible label and no glare. {style_lock} No text, no logo overlay, no props, no watermark.

shots.intent: 强调每天一包的定量与新鲜锁鲜
shots.camera: top-down flat lay of pouch and opened daily pack
shots.lighting: soft even key from the upper-left
shots.props: one opened small pack spilling a few nuts
shots.promptTemplate: {product_identity_lock} Top-down flat lay of {product}: the main pouch beside one opened 30g single-serve pack with a few nuts and dried fruit spilling out naturally on clean white paper. Soft even key light from the upper-left with real contact shadows; nuts look fresh with natural texture, not oily. Product and pack occupy 30-35%. Leave a clean empty vertical band on the left. {style_lock} No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用颗粒与果干质感证明真材实料
shots.camera: macro top-down, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: raking side light to reveal texture
shots.props: a few whole almonds, walnuts and cranberries
shots.promptTemplate: {product_identity_lock} Extreme macro of a mix of whole almonds, walnut halves and dried cranberries from {product} arranged on a matte light oak surface, top-down, shallow depth of field. Raking side light reveals natural ridges, skins and fruit texture; honest matte look with no oil or syrup sheen. Leave a clean empty strip at the bottom. {style_lock} No text, no logo, no watermark.

shots.intent: 唤醒午后加餐的使用场景
shots.lighting: natural window light from the left
shots.background: bright desk with a notebook, mug and small plant
shots.promptTemplate: {product_identity_lock} Lifestyle scene of {product} on a bright desk during an afternoon break, the pouch and one opened pack beside a notebook, a mug and a small plant softly out of focus. Eye-level 3/4 framing, natural window light from the left with realistic soft shadows. Product occupies 20-25% and stays the sharpest element; props must not cover it. Leave clean space at the upper left. {style_lock} No text, no logos, no watermark.

shots.intent: 对比油炸膨化零食突出轻负担
shots.lighting: even soft light identical on both halves
shots.background: clean white with a subtle center divider
shots.props: a small pile of fried chips on the left half
shots.textZone: top of each half reserved, empty
shots.promptTemplate: {product_identity_lock} Top-down split comparison on clean white: on one side {product} with nuts and dried fruit, on the other side a small pile of fried chips. Identical soft lighting and framing so the difference reads as baked-nuts versus fried-snack. Product occupies 35-40%. Leave clean label zones at the top of each half. {style_lock} No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.

shots.displayName: 原料新鲜无添加信任图
shots.intent: 用散料与洁净陈列建立新鲜与无添加信任
shots.props: scattered raw nuts and a blank clean card
shots.promptTemplate: {product_identity_lock} Flat-lay trust composition of {product} on natural linen over light oak, surrounded by a few scattered raw nuts and one blank clean card area reserved for a fact graphic. Even high-key soft lighting, honest natural materials. Product occupies 30-35% and stays the sharpest subject. Leave the right side clean and empty. {style_lock} No text, no logo, no watermark, do not invent certifications or health claims.

shots.intent: 用多袋组合与促销区促成加购
shots.lighting: bright soft key with a warm accent
shots.background: clean white with a #3B7A57 accent band
shots.props: three pouches arranged as a bundle
shots.textZone: top and bottom banner reserved, empty
shots.promptTemplate: {product_identity_lock} Promotional grouping of {product} shown as a three-pouch bundle on a clean white surface with a thin #3B7A57 accent band, slight low-angle hero framing. Bright soft key light with a subtle warm accent and real contact shadows. Pouches occupy 40-45% and stay sharply separated. Leave clean empty banner zones at the top and bottom for offer copy. {style_lock} No text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 由爆款套图吸取视觉语法后重写，已脱离原图商品与文案。
